description: You are a layout artist at an animation studio. You need to composite the walk cycle character animation over a background to create a complete shot. The character animation is at /home/ga/OpenToonz/samples/dwanko_run.tnz. A background image for the shot has been placed at /home/ga/OpenToonz/backgrounds/scene_background.jpg. Open the character animation scene in OpenToonz, import the background image as a new layer, position it behind the character animation, and render the composite result as a PNG frame sequence (at least 20 frames) to /home/ga/OpenToonz/output/composite_frames/. Use 1920x1080 resolution for the final composite.
